scope: Local source supply. Product entity or transaction membership is not certified.

rows.source: title original selected fields and separately marked processed extract; source hashes and PK namespace
rows.base_date: Title source base date when known; otherwise null. Snapshot month is separate.
rows.trust_state: identity status when observed, or last_seen_not_observed
rows.product_use: Source display permitted; candidate research only when observed and canonical; new enrichment, aggregation and regression prohibited.

rows.source: Frozen trait cache, original ZIP inventory and original DBF payload where already captured
rows.base_date: Selected source observation cutoff plus the preserved raw row trait_asof
rows.last_seen: Last parcel observation release; old value is not automatically used
rows.product_use: Source display and candidate research only when present; new enrichment, aggregation and regression prohibited.

rows.source: Price observation preserved separately from trait attribute content version
rows.base_date: Source price_year; never copied from title snapshot when unknown
rows.trust_state: positive_known_year, source_overflow, unknown_price_year, missing_or_nonpositive, not_observed_in_selected_snapshot, identity_blocked, or last_seen_not_observed
rows.last_seen: Last parcel source observation release; unavailable current price is not filled from history
rows.product_use: Candidate research requires a positive price with known year and current canonical building address; new enrichment, quantity aggregation and regression prohibited.

forbidden_inferences: parcel identity implies complete building site
source parent edge implies transaction ownership
value exists implies permission to use it
price sum across multiple titles of one parcel
